English.Char_Desc_450: Inspect devices, package sources and available Windows driver update offers. By Aurelio Avila. Review limitations and access requirements on the official product page. Windows downloads are publisher-signed and timestamped; signing is not a safety guarantee. Screenshots illustrate the app and may show an earlier release.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Tweaky Driver by Aurelio Avila separates detected Windows devices from eligible driver offers. Review installed and available versions and package sources before downloading. Free access includes inventory and a limited-source scan; Pro extends supported sources and eligible downloads. Driver detection does not establish compatibility, and universal hardware coverage or a performance gain is not promised. Some packages are download-only; installation remains a separate reviewed step. The screenshot is a genuine earlier 0.1.4 initial-state capture, not proof of the current interface or driver coverage. Official Windows downloads are publisher-signed and timestamped. Signing does not guarantee safety.
